p_about1: Hello! My name is Matvey, I am a developer and a moviemaker. I have experience in web and software development in more than 10 different languages.
p_about2: I became involved in this work in the 7th grade, when I wrote my first program. Since then, the hobby has grown into a profession. I also like to share my knowledge: I run a YouTube channel where I talk about programming.
work1_desc: Internship with an employment of 30 hours a week. I worked in the video player team of 'Kinopoisk' which is streaming service with an audience of millions. Dealing with buttons, timelines and other control elements: maintenance, improvement and development of new features.
work2_desc: Full-time job in retail: development of interfaces for employees related to content management and sales in the 'Yandex Eats' services. Working with admin panels, mainly in the B2B sector.
work3_desc: Geoservices of the Autonomous transport team. Tools for working with maps for rovers (delivery robots) and self-driving cars (experimental stage of self-driving taxis). Interaction with cartographers and optimization of 3D visualizations on the web.
edu1_desc: I graduated from the school №734 with the highest possible grades, a red diploma and two gold medals. During the education process I tried to expand my knowledge in various academic fields. I participated in olympiads and school-wide events, which allowed me to improve my hard and soft skills.
edu2_desc: Currently I am studying at the Moscow Polytech, at the Faculty of Information Technologies, majoring in Computer Science and Computer Engineering (Web Technologies program). My desire for self-development also helped here: the grade point average, based on the exams, tends to the highest mark (5).
